newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. State Electric amends plan.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. State Electric amends plan.

text.p: New York State Electric & Gas Corp (NYSEG) said on Friday that it filed with the Public Service Commission (PSC) a petition requesting permission to form a holding company.
NYSEG plans to transfer designated fossil and hydropower generation assets to a generation company within the holding company structure.
On September 27, 1996, NYSEG filed an electric restructuring plan (NYSEGPlan) to comply with the PSC of the State of New York's Competitive Opportunities Proceeding order issued on May 20, 1996.

In addition to a 5-year rate freeze, the plan calls for wholesale competition to begin on August 1, 1997 and for the functional separation of generating assets from the rest of the company's operations.
